Its window (Homm3ConfluxMagicUniversityWindow) lets a hero in town learn Daylight, Nightshade, Arcane or Primal Magic for 2500 Gold each, the four Olden Era schools standing in for HoMM3's Air/Earth/Fire/Water.
The HoMM3 Conflux Resource Silo makes 1 Mercury daily; the row matches.
Generated city row grants +10 weekly growth to Pixie/Sprite lines.
Generated city row grants +1 weekly growth to Firebird/Phoenix lines.

Building pass 2026-11-22: the grail carries the native magicGuildExpandMagics city bonus (the vanilla Frigid Firmament lever), so every Mage Guild level built here offers all spells of its tier; it keeps +1 empire growth and +100% city growth (owner answer 3).

Elemental Fusion (user design 2026-11-15) replaces Elemental Conjury under the same skill SID: every rank grants the homm3_conflux_elemental_fusion world spell (Necromancer Will clone, no mana cost, unlimited uses) that permanently fuses two elemental stacks into one of 105 generated h3_fusion_* units (custom_factions/conflux_fusion); 37 named recipes fuse two fused units again into a stage-2 h3_fusion_ii_* unit with its own signature. Basic unlocks Air/Water/Fire, Advanced adds Earth, Expert adds Psychic. HoMM3 has no fusion; the fused units are never recruited. Advanced/Expert subskill SIDs keep elemental_conjury tokens for save compatibility; Stable Bond/Perfect Fusion give fused units +2 Defense/+2 Attack.
